evidence.quote: The mixture-of-experts model has 2.4 trillion parameters but activates only 71 billion per token, according to the Qwen team.
It processes images natively and offers a one-million-token context window.

title: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max takes on Opus 5.5, GPT-6, and Kimi K3.1 Pro at much lower prices
displayTitle: 阿里推出 Qwen4-Max，主打长上下文与任务成本
summary: 报道介绍阿里推出 Qwen4-Max：模型总参数 2.4 万亿、每 token 激活 710 亿参数，原生处理图像并提供百万 token 上下文。各项能力与成本表现主要来自阿里测试，不能视为独立复现。
